async function vizRep(gc) { let map = 'data:image/png;base64,'; let icon = 'data:image/png;base64,'; await gc.setVariable('name', await gc.expression.attrvalByName('Name'), false); await gc.setVariable('x_rel', 0, true); await gc.setVariable('y_rel', 0, true); await gc.setVariable('z_rel', 2, true); await gc.graphic_cube(4, 4, 4, 'grey', map); await gc.graphic_text(await gc.getVariableValue('x_rel'), await gc.getVariableValue('y_rel'), await gc.getVariableValue('z_rel'), 0.2, 'gray', await gc.getVariableValue('name'), 'x_rel', 'y_rel', 'z_rel'); }

classes.description: The joint element describes the kinematics and dynamics of the joint

attributes.name: Axis
attributes.description: The joint axis specified in the joint frame.

attribute_type.name: Axis type
attribute_type.description: This is the axis of rotation for revolute joints, the axis of translation for prismatic joints, and the surface normal for planar joints. The axis is specified in the joint frame of reference. Fixed and floating

attribute_type.description: This is the float attribute type

attributes.name: Dynamics
attributes.description: An element specifying physical properties of the joint.

attribute.name: Damping
attribute.description: The physical damping value of the joint

attribute_type.name: Damping type
attribute_type.description: In newton-seconds per metre [N∙s/m] for prismatic joints, in newton-metre-seconds per radian [N∙m∙s/rad] for revolute joints.

attribute.name: Friction
attribute.description: The physical static friction value of the joint

attribute_type.name: Friction type
attribute_type.description: In newtons [N] for prismatic joints, in newton-metres [N∙m] for revolute joints.

attribute.name: Soft lower limit
attribute.description: An attribute specifying the lower joint boundary where the safety controller starts limiting the position of the joint. This limit needs to be larger than the lower joint limit.

attribute_type.name: Joint type
attribute_type.description: In radians for revolute joints, in metres for prismatic joints

attribute.name: Soft upper limit
attribute.description: An attribute specifying the upper joint boundary where the safety controller starts limiting the position of the joint. This limit needs to be smaller than the upper joint limit.

attribute_type.name: Joint type
attribute_type.description: In radians for revolute joints, in metres for prismatic joints

attribute.name: K position
attribute.description: The k_position term determines the scale of the bound on velocity.

attribute.name: K velocity
attribute.description: An attribute specifying the relation between effort and velocity limits.

attribute_type.name: Velocity type
attribute_type.description: In radians per second [rad/s] for revolute joints, in metres per second [m/s] for prismatic joints

attribute.name: Effort
attribute.description: An attribute for enforcing the maximum joint effort

attribute_type.name: Effort type
attribute_type.description: |applied effort| < |effort|

attribute.name: Lower
attribute.description: An attribute specifying the lower joint limit

attribute_type.name: Joint type
attribute_type.description: In radians for revolute joints, in metres for prismatic joints

attribute.name: Upper

attribute.name: Velocity
